purpose: Keep the shared Ordivon world model revisable while distinguishing historical observation validity from current owner-state freshness; owner revision movement creates review pressure but never a shared claim by itself.

worldModel.definition: The current compressed set of revisable claims used by Ordivon to distinguish participants, capability, work, evidence, consequence, world interaction, value-relevant constraints, and durable responsibilities.

stages.rule: Bind the exact historically observed project revision and the selected owner source HEAD, classify their Git relation, and retain only revision/relation evidence needed for review; do not copy mutable owner state into Computing.
Record a new distinction, contradiction, failed assumption, causal relation, scope limit, or repeated cross-project pattern that may challenge the current shared world model.
Keep local claims local unless a materially different project or strong external baseline supports the broader relation; contradictory evidence remains first-class.
Retain, narrow, split, supersede, or revise a shared claim with explicit prior claim, evidence, scope, limitations, and falsifier.
Translate a changed shared claim into project-specific questions or deletion/re-audit triggers; never into automatic product edits.
Affected projects independently test the implication under their own authority and return exact evidence references.
Compare returned evidence with the revised claim and with the loop method itself; reopen either when practice contradicts it.

specializedMethods.scope: bounded experiment-local declaration discipline; semantic oracle and owner truth remain external to the template
bounded candidate experiment campaigns including cross-evidence-family self-reform after prerequisite evidence exists

scientificInstrumentation.principle: Use deterministic/classical machinery to capture, freeze, execute, count, query, diff, and aggregate evidence; keep problem selection, causal interpretation, semantic applicability, world-model revision, and reform proposals with the Agent and owner/domain evaluators.
scientificInstrumentation.ownerEvidence: Owner-native exporters/receipts remain truth. EvidencePack is a bounded immutable analysis input, not an owner-state copy or completeness claim beyond supplied bundles.
scientificInstrumentation.matrix: Experiment Matrix owns factor/replicate expansion, bounded subprocess mechanics, terminal record identity, and replay of already-recorded terminal trials. It owns neither scientific scoring nor external-effect recovery across the command-to-record crash gap.
scientificInstrumentation.analysis: JSONL/Parquet/DuckDB are rebuildable analytical projections. Query results may reduce model context but cannot upgrade measurements into semantic truth.
scientificInstrumentation.pressure: PressurePack may expose exact revision relation, changed paths, commit samples, truncation, and UNKNOWN. It must not emit importance, priority, topology, tractability, recommended action, or world-model change.
scientificInstrumentation.contraction: Contraction verification may prove Agent-declared retired paths remain Git-recoverable, current paths are absent, an exact gate binds the current revision, and executable census is clean. The verifier must never choose deletion scope, perform deletion, publish, or decide semantic retention.
scientificInstrumentation.applicability: Externalize applicability dependencies before admitting a new consequence. After exact owner admission, hand recovery to the admitted Effect/request identity and its replay/dispatch/reconciliation contract; do not keep re-applying generic currentness unless a new admission is actually required.
scientificInstrumentation.stopping: Fresh synthesis after dependency coverage remains supported for search inertia. P11 rejects generic order canonicalization on the tested Finance workload: first clarify the semantic target/oracle, then use order perturbation only if a residual reproduces. Deterministic ordering is mechanical only when owner semantics declare unordered presentation or explicit sequence identity.
